caption:
Elon Musk lost $750 billion after Tesla and SpaceX crashed, more than Bezos, Page, and Brin are worth combined. Swipe for the full breakdown 💸

SpaceX's blockbuster June IPO pushed Musk past $1 trillion, both stocks crashed within weeks wiping $750 billion, his loss exceeds the combined fortunes of Jeff Bezos, Larry Page, and Sergey Brin, and he coined 'former trillionaire' like losing three fortunes was a bit.

When one person can lose more wealth than three of the richest humans on Earth built in their lifetimes, and laugh about it, money at this scale stopped being real a long time ago.

hook_tournament.why: It stacks every gut-punch in one sentence: the rise ('world's first trillionaire'), the fall ($750 billion, in weeks), AND his own punchline quote — you get the full wild arc without needing to swipe to understand why it matters. The runner-up [0] lands the Bezos comparison hard but front-loads the loss without the quote, so it reads like a headline instead of a story you have to see.
